components.instructions: Large 16:9 container spanning full width with 'showreel_poster' image, featuring a glowing #FF5500 play button in center.

grids: bento grid (Tetris Mode) for Instagram layouts
1-column mobile, 2-column or asymmetrical multi-column for desktop project pages to let photos breathe
layouts: Asymmetrical splits (text on one side, massive bleeding image on the other)
Edge-to-edge full bleed containers without standard max-w constraints for photo showcases
motion: Slow parallax scrolling on hero background images
Fade up and reveal animations for typography on scroll
Hover states on images that slightly scale them up (scale-105) with long transition duration (duration-700)
accessibility: Ensure all text over images has a gradient overlay behind it for at least 4.5:1 contrast
Provide aria-labels for all image grid items
All interactive elements must include data-testid attribute
instructions_to_main_agent: Focus purely on a cinematic, photography-first experience. Use massive typography (Bebas Neue) and edge-to-edge images. Let the dark negative space (#080808) create drama. Avoid typical SaaS UI components like cards with padding and borders. Photography and video posters should dominate the real estate.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and glass-morphism effects.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡.
Do not center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is banned).
Use modern button styles relevant to the cinematic brand.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
DO NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Use specific properties.
All interactive elements must include data-testid attribute for testing.
